goal: Implement corrected Phase 0 — Provenance decision and inventory from TAILTRAIL-BUNDLED-OFFLINE-AIDLC-PROVISIONING-DESIGN.md: extend scripts/aidlc-official-install.py to acquire one pinned official AIDLC release, resolve its full commit, verify the archive SHA-256 and MIT-0 license, compare the complete checked-in rule inventory against the authenticated upstream bytes, preserve exact matches and replace only verified mismatches within the two rule directories, generate aidlc-rules/PROVENANCE.json, aidlc-rules/LICENSE, and aidlc-rules/BUNDLE_VERSION, retain aidlc-rules/VERSION only as non-authoritative legacy inspection input, and record the compatibility, trust-posture, source-checkout, schema-v1/v2, active-run, external-pack, and host-projection decisions required by Phase 0; exclude packaging manifests, runtime resolution, Full routing, and host adapters.

positive: One published official AIDLC tag, its full commit, release archive SHA-256, and exact MIT-0 license bytes are acquired from the official upstream and recorded together.
The complete current inventory of 30 rule files is compared by safe relative path and SHA-256 with the official archive; exact files are preserved and only verified mismatches are replaced.

PROVENANCE.json records acquisition, verification, archive, license, rule inventory, trust-posture, compatibility, migration, active-run, external-pack, and host-projection decisions without claiming to be an independent trust anchor.
BUNDLE_VERSION is separate from the official upstream revision; legacy VERSION is never treated as provenance.
The authenticated-release, development-local, corruption-detection-only, and external-explicit postures are explicit, and production Full fails closed when the required trust evidence is absent.

The focused proof exercises safe archive validation, closed inventory comparison, mismatch replacement, exact-match preservation, metadata generation, unsafe-path rejection, incomplete-acquisition failure, and deterministic output.
negative: No provenance claim may be derived only from aidlc-rules/VERSION, local filenames, or self-generated hashes.
No unverified local rule byte may be labelled as part of the pinned official release.
No rule outside aidlc-rules/aws-aidlc-rules and aidlc-rules/aws-aidlc-rule-details may be replaced, and no mismatch may be replaced before upstream archive and source identity verification succeeds.
No package manifest, source-distribution manifest, release manifest, resolver, Full-mode route, project projection, or host adapter may be changed in Phase 0.
No runtime network dependency, silent Full-to-Lite downgrade, weakened integrity check, fabricated acquisition evidence, or publisher-authentication claim from local hashes may be introduced.
Failure to acquire or verify the official tag, full commit, archive, license, or complete inventory must fail closed without writing partial Phase 0 outputs.
